target: Exact Figure12 / Appendix H.2 Gross circuit in arXiv:2603.05481v1
reason: The frozen obstruction certificates are conditional on a stationary all-round-translate timing model that was never exercised on a circuit the paper calls valid. Advisory review identifies this as the load-bearing gap. Before any target adjudication is carried forward, the identical methodology must be tested on the authors' generic left-right circuit, whose schedule, staggering and one-round non-interleaving claim are stated in pinned source.
canonical_preregistration: Copy these exact bytes to successor inputs/preregistration.json and verify SHA256 against manifest.prereg_sha256 before any new derivation.
control_design: Build the generic LRC for the canonical gross code with left=L block, right=R block, and explicit proper edge colourings of L_X, R_X, L_Z, R_Z derived from the polynomial structure. Record the colourings; do not treat them as the authors' Figure12 colouring.

Derive per-check chronological CNOT times, preparations and measurements from 03-left-right-circuits.tex:29-49, with the explicit wrap-around round identification: an X ancilla prepared at1 and measured at t1+t2+2 within a round; a Z ancilla prepared at t1+3 of round k and measured at t1+2 of round k+1. State this convention explicitly and check it against the pinned constructor block structure rather than asserting it.

Feed the resulting schedule to the frozen prove_local_timing criterion (all relative round translates), the one-round criterion (k=0 only), and the residual/hook-propagation derivation. A criterion that rejects the generic LRC is not a valid Figure12 admission criterion.

Build the same schedule through the pinned constructor to compare finite one-cycle operation lists, preparation/measurement times and detector structure. Reuse only the pinned constructor module; do not modify it.

Derive residual classes from explicit Pauli propagation of a single ancilla hook rather than an assumed prefix/suffix formula; compare against the paper's residual definition and its 90-residual-set count where applicable.
Only then reassess Figure12 under whichever criteria survive the control. Distinguish a genuine refutation of the literal reading from an artifact of the stationary all-translate model.
admission_requires: Author-supported modified shared clocks and cycle association
Specified finite preparation/readout/idle operation and error-location set for the one-cycle experiment
downstream_gate: Only after exact admission: independently derive primitive faults with same-location branch exclusivity, validate direct replay/negative controls and then run the inherited capped assay. No physical model of an unadmitted substitute may stand in for the target.
prohibited: Repeated searches or unchanged metadata sweeps
disposition: Freeze through campaign.py after the control verdict and target reassessment. FROZEN-INCONCLUSIVE if exact source admission is still unmet; if the control refutes the frozen obstruction model, record that retraction explicitly in the research card.
